content.name: Jordan Pereira
content.title: Operations Coordinator
content.summary: Business graduate from Curtin University in a first operations role at a mining equipment supplier, after two years running casual shifts in retail. Coordinates daily dispatch to 30 Pilbara and Goldfields sites and cut urgent freight spend by 19% in the first year.

experience.title: Operations Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate dispatch of parts and consumables to 30 mine sites, working with three road and air freight carriers.
Introduced a daily cut-off and consolidation rule for site orders, cutting urgent freight spend by 19% in twelve months.
Maintain stock levels for 1,800 fast-moving items in the warehouse system and run weekly cycle counts.
Prepare a weekly on-time-in-full report for the operations manager and branch customers.

experience.title: Casual Team Leader
bullets: Opened and closed the store on weekends, leading a team of six casual staff.
Reorganised the stockroom by category so weekly deliveries were shelved in half the time.
Trained new starters on the point-of-sale system and cash handling.

education.degree: Bachelor of Commerce (Logistics and Supply Chain Management)
education.details: Weighted average mark 74; capstone on inventory policy for a local agricultural co-op

achievements.title: Urgent freight down 19%
achievements.detail: Order consolidation rule at Ironstone Equipment Supply.
